title: Two at Once
label: ch:ar-two-at-once
canDo: I can join two nouns with و, offer a choice with أو, turn a clause against the one before it with لكن, and accept what somebody said with حسنًا.

payoff.summary: The pantry and family of chapters 33-36 -- tea, coffee, milk, sugar, salt, meat, cheese, food, a cup, a spoon, a son, a daughter, a neighbour, a friend -- becomes combinable for the first time, joined, offered and turned.
payoff.note: و is the commonest word in written Arabic and was glossed once, in chapter 1, inside a fixed reply that introduced no atom.
